titulo.alumno: «A casa onde cresci»: the house where I grew up

intro: Read the text and notice a habitual description in the imperfect and a biographical detail.

palabras.significado: In context: The house where I grew up was on a narrow street, near the market.

texto: Recognise a habitual description in the imperfect and a biographical detail.
Compare the literal information with the purpose of the text; don't add details that don't appear.
